decision: Companion changes already go through shiftCharacter(delta) into reduceCharacterSlide. Chevrons, half taps, and arrow keys all use that path. Running and paused return before any slide.
why: A swipe has to reuse the 300ms ease-out, retarget, reduced-motion snap, and idle lock instead of a second animator.

decision: Gesture result is {kind: tap|horizontal-swipe|vertical-scroll, delta: 0|1|-1}. Constants SWIPE_MIN_PX=40 and SWIPE_AXIS_RATIO=1.5. Finger left (dx<0) is delta 1 (next); finger right is delta -1 (previous). Only horizontal-swipe calls shiftCharacter.
why: Same slide state machine. A non-swipe of 40px or more suppresses the half-tap click so a swipe cannot double-fire. Under 40px stays a tap, matching v9.1.0 half taps.

evidence: shiftCharacter already cancels the previous pair before starting the next
